# comaps

**Offline vector maps with search and car, bike and foot routing, from CoMaps' own map files**

- **Version recorded:** 2026.08.31-14
- **Categories:** `navigation-maps`
- **Upstream:** <https://www.comaps.app/>

## What it does

A map and navigator in the style of a phone app: vector maps drawn on the machine, search for places, addresses and postcodes from an index inside each map file, and routes by car, bike, on foot and by public transport, with contours and speed cameras where the map carries them. Everything runs from files on the disk, so none of it needs a network. It reads CoMaps' own map format, which `comaps-maps` downloads for your regions.

## Why you would want it

One program that finds an address and routes to it offline, with modern rendering, beside Navit (turn-by-turn from gpsd) and QMapShack (trails and terrain). It is the desktop build of the CoMaps phone app, a community fork of Organic Maps, so the laptop and a phone can carry the same maps.

## Before it will work

Map regions set in station config (`hammunition station set --map-regions ...`) and `comaps-maps` installed for them; without maps it shows only the World overview. Start it from the menu entry "CoMaps with your offline maps", which runs `hammunition maps comaps`.

## Known problems

No "you are here" on the laptop yet. CoMaps on Linux reads its position from GeoClue2 only, by name: it has no gpsd client and no NMEA reader, and GeoClue must also be told to allow app.comaps.comaps, which Parrot's GeoClue configuration does not. Feeding the GPS to GeoClue through its network-NMEA source is the route, unmeasured and not done by Hammunition; the navigation guide says what it would take. Built from source: a first install downloads the source and its submodules and compiles for tens of minutes (about 12 minutes measured on an 8-core laptop at two jobs, by hand). Upstream installs its own menu entry, "CoMaps", under its own categories; that one starts CoMaps without the launcher's preparation, so its first start shows the licence dialog and it does not see Hammunition's maps. `uninstall` refuses it, as it does every build whose own install rule wrote into /usr/local (the rule leaves no file list to reverse); what it wrote is in the transaction log. US address-search quality has not been measured.

## Keeping it current

- probe: github tags
- strategy: rebuild
- CoMaps tags a release every few weeks. Move the tag and its commit together, to one a distribution builds (Flathub's manifest names both), then regenerate catalog/data/comaps-pins.yaml with scripts/gen_comaps_pins.py: the maps must be the version the app's own index names.
